events.title: New in Bravemech: dynamic lighting, and Bravecore overdrive glows
events.summary: Until now every mech had its light painted into its art. A blue beam passing right under it or an explosion next to it didn't change how it looked. Dynamic lighting changes that, and it went live in 0.73.342 at High and Medium quality on desktop. How it works The game reads which way each part of a mech faces straight from its art, so every sprite mech catches light without being redrawn. events.summary: 0.73 went live on 30 September with the new look. Since then we have shipped over 300 patches on top of it, so here are the big ones in one place. The full list is in the in-game patch notes. The Century Campaign is open The story mode now sits at the top of the title menu, above the Pilot Campaign, and anyone can play it. events.title: Bravemech 0.73 is live: a new look for every screen
events.summary: The 0.73 update is live. Every menu, the battle HUD, the tutorial and the story scenes now share the title screen's look: gold highlights, darker glass panels, clearer labels. The whole shell was rebuilt, not just reskinned.Alongside it: new mech art and animation for the frames we have reworked, a remastered soundtrack, and new recorded battle audio for launch clamps, kills and command ceremonies.The free demo runs this build right now on Steam, free to play at store.steampowered.com/app/495772

events.title: Free demo is LIVE — Bravemech: The Century War
events.summary: The free demo is live on Steam. It’s the tutorial that teaches you how to play and showcases the core game mechanics — jump in, learn the ropes, and get a feel for the fight. Solo or up to 4-player local co-op. Play it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4863090/ When you’re in, tell us what you think. We read it. See you on the front. — Bravemech Studio

events.title: Free demo coming soon to Bravemech: The Century War
events.summary: The Century War will last a hundred years. You fly its first one, and you do not win it.
